auditKind: Read-only native receipt, raw input, and verifier-source crosscheck
executionBoundary: Only built-in Node data parsing and hashing were executed. No project code or project imports, build, test, simulation, browser, server, HTTP request, probe, or proof rerun was executed by this audit.

sourceProvenanceSummary.digestMethod: Actual source-input byte hashes, listed file order, path+NUL+SHA256+LF
Actual source-input byte hashes, listed file order, path+NUL+SHA256+LF

differenceFromEmbedded.receiptCoverage: Both native receipts name session inputs ending at tick 40. Neither native receipt certifies the standalone replay endpoint at tick 43.

verifierSourceInspection.description: Manually inspected the saved TypeScript verifier and its compiled main verification block. The saved source and bundle contain the following checks before producing passed receipts.

assertionReferences.check: Current SAVE_VERSION and SIMULATION_REVISION required; native decoder preserves raw game envelope and saveGame roundtrip equals it.
Replay consumes all actions; endpoint tick/checksum/full game envelope, analysis and technology timings equal the raw input.
After every accepted continuation command and each natural tick, compare full game envelopes, both recorder exports, and expected accepted command history.
Issue hold, stop, unqueued move, queued move, hold, stop; advance5+5+60+5+25=100 ticks; queued move adds an order; movement displacement must exceed0.01.
Both extended archives equal and replay to the full continued game envelope with matching analysis and technology timings.
Source/config provenance compared before and after verification; output hashes bind input, checker source and executed bundle.

verifierSourceInspection.gamepadBranch: The optional gamepad/browser-sidecar assertions are in source103-120 and bundle11292-11310. These two receipts have no gamepad field; six-command counts here refer to native continuation, while each raw exported replay contains two commands.
verifierSourceInspection.gameEnvelopeScope: The explicit complete-envelope assertions compare the entire raw game envelope including saved state/runtime. They do not assert reserialization equality for the complete top-level session planning envelope.

limits: This inspection directly verified saved bytes, schema/endpoints, command values, hashes, report relationships, source assertions and log consistency. It did not independently reproduce decoder/playback/continuation behavior, movement, extended replay hash, or checkpoint hashes.
Passing runtime assertions and sourceUnchangedDuringVerification are saved receipt claims. No live checkout/Git provenance recheck or build reproduction occurred.
Native receipts cover the tick-40 session inputs. The standalone tick-43 replay has matching schema and command history, but its endpoint is outside these native receipts.
No physical controller hardware or browser-control behavior is certified by this native audit.
The source/config digest covers the170 listed src/config inputs; the checker script is separately hash-bound.

hashMethods.rawFileHashes: SHA256 over fs.readFileSync Buffer, with no decoding or normalization.
hashMethods.gameEnvelopeSha256: Read saved session bytes; JSON.parse UTF-8 text; SHA256 over the UTF-8 bytes of JavaScript JSON.stringify(input.game). This uses the same JSON.stringify operation as hashJson(input.game) in verify-native.ts22 and218. It is not a Python JSON dump, canonical key sort, or hash of pretty-printed input text.
hashMethods.provenanceDigest: For each listed source/config file, hash the actual packaged file bytes, preserve the listed file ordering, concatenate path + NUL + actual SHA256 hex + LF, then SHA256 the UTF-8 concatenation. Each actual file hash and length was also compared independently against the receipt.
hashMethods.buildId: For listed src/*.ts and src/*.css files in the listed order, update SHA256 with the path after src/ and then its actual packaged file bytes, matching verify-native.ts60-64. No project code is loaded.
hashMethods.semanticComparisons: Parse saved JSON with Node JSON.parse; compare JSON.stringify values in preserved property order. For the two sessions this yielded equality. Actual bytes were also checked separately to establish that the report session adds one trailing LF.
